pages.main_text: EP 5: Taco Bell’s Former CEO, Greg Creed, Reflects On How To Build An Ownable Company Culture That Inspires Innovation A Meeting of the Minds: Mark King sits down with Taco Bell legend Greg Creed to discuss the importance of living más. August 18, 2021 Restless Creativity Innovation People Business Share on Facebook Share on Twitter At Taco Bell, we believe that part of living más is restlessly continuing to push the boundaries in everything we do. Sometimes that means taking a moment to appreciate all the things we have already accomplished in our history as a brand in order to continue being bolder in the future. In today's episode, CEO Mark King chats with former CEO of Taco Bell and Yum! Brands Greg Creed to discuss Greg's new book, how Taco Bell has made a memorable impact in the QSR world throughout the years, the importance of continually building a unique and ownable company culture that inspires innovation and, most excitingly, the "comeback" of our breakfast menu which has a special place in both of these CEOs hearts (and stomachs).
